desc: Stickman at lower-left is gone at the cut and the PitchBook screenshot begins shrinking and moving up; frame-to-frame zoom, not a new scene.
Screenshot keeps scaling up and sliding upward; hero banner clipped at top, no stickman. Same page, continuous zoom.
Page enlarges further; headline and body paragraphs move up and grow across the three tiles. Continuous zoom.
Same article zooming in; hero banner shifts off the top while body text grows.
Zoom continues; banner partly cropped at top, body paragraphs larger. Same screenshot.
Banner scrolls out the top while the article body enlarges; smooth zoom/pan.
Hero banner mostly cropped away; body text keeps growing across tiles.
Only a thin strip of banner remains at top; text blocks larger in each tile. Continuous pan/zoom.
Banner shrinks to a sliver; body paragraphs now fill the lower middle. Same page.
Banner nearly out of frame; paragraph text keeps enlarging. Zoom in progress.
Banner strip vanishing at top; text columns widen. Same zoom sequence.
Last banner remnant scrolls off; only body text remains, larger each tile.
Banner gone in the cut and post tiles; paragraphs fill the page area. End of zoom before the stickman reappears.
Hard cut from the glasses man, yellow bond and percent circle to a skyscraper labelled BIG BUSINESS and a LOAN document.
Hard cut from the rate chart with '3%' note and stickman to a zoomed-out Federal Reserve web page.
Federal Reserve page scales up and scrolls so the projections table moves into view; same page.
Page keeps zooming in and scrolling down; table larger in each tile.
Continued zoom/scroll; the table header rows rise toward the middle of the frame.
Scroll and zoom continue; table rows now fill the lower half. Same page.
Page nearly at final scale with the projections table lower centre; motion decelerating.
Federal Reserve page scrolls down; table moves up and more text appears below it.
Scrolling continues; the table drifts upward and a footnote block comes into view.
Page scroll in progress; table close to the top and notes text growing below.
Table leaving the top, footnote paragraphs and Figure 1 heading arriving; scroll.
Scroll continues: Figure 1 median-projections tables move up the page.
Page scrolling downward; change-in-real-GDP table drifts up, unemployment table appears.
Scroll continues; unemployment-rate table rises with PCE heading below.
Same downward scroll; unemployment table near top, PCE inflation heading entering.
Scroll continues past the unemployment table toward the PCE inflation table.
PCE inflation heading and table move upward as the page scrolls.
Scroll in progress; PCE and core PCE sections drift up the page.
Page keeps scrolling; core PCE table rising into the upper half.
Scroll continues; core PCE table now at middle and a note paragraph below.
Core PCE table scrolls up; the Figure 2 heading starts appearing at the bottom.
Scroll nearly at rest; Figure 2 midpoint table entering from the bottom.
Figure 2 heading and table rise; motion slowing toward rest.
Scroll decelerates; Figure 2 table moves up with small step per tile.
Page zooms in on Figure 2: table and header grow, page margins move outward.
Zoom-in continues; table text larger, navigation bar crops at top.
Table enlarges and the page width exceeds the frame; same page.
Further zoom; Figure 2 table fills more of the frame and the header is cropped.
Zoom continues with the table filling the width; nav bar partly cut.
Table keeps growing; left grey page border drifts out of frame.
Near-final zoom of Figure 2 with headline at top; motion slowing.
Zoom almost complete; table fills the frame, page border at left edge.
Final zoom steps before highlights appear; table nearly at full scale, no overlay yet.
